question.problem:
Let $R=[-3,1]\times [-4,0]$ be a region in the $xy$-plane, and let $f(x,y)=11-3x-4y.$
Further, let $P$ be a partition of $R,$ where

$$
\begin{aligned}{P}_{1}=\{{x}_{0},{x}_{1},…,{x}_{m}\},\,{P}_{2}=\{{y}_{0},{y}_{1},…,{y}_{n}\},\,P={P}_{1}\times {P}_{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Given that the lower Riemann sum of $f$ with respect to $P$ is given by

$$
L(f,P)={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}\boxed{}\,Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}
$$

where $Δ{x}_{i}={x}_{i}-{x}_{i-1}$ and $Δ{y}_{j}={y}_{j}-{y}_{j-1},$ what is the missing expression in the double summation above?
question.worked_solution:
The lower Riemann sum is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}L(f,P) & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}{m}_{ij}Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}\end{aligned}
$$

where ${m}_{ij}$ is the *minimum* value of $f$ in each subregion ${R}_{ij}.$ 

We consider an arbitrary subregion ${R}_{ij}$ of the partition. This subregion lies between ${x}_{i-1}$ and ${x}_{i}$ over the $x$-axis and ${y}_{i-1}$ and ${y}_{i}$ over the $y$-axis, as shown below. 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14255149/assets/88ffe30ae5401e00502b35d851b216768aad69bf94236561617adf23e1ce058f.png)

Notice that:

- $f(x,y)=11-3x-4y$ decreases as $x$ increases, and

- $f(x,y)=11-3x-4y$ decreases as $y$ increases.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14255149/assets/ce0d90127e1f14654f4b32a933f1eb6e76e054c03f19ca40c3f04116aa3c2c93.png)

As a result, the *minimum* value of $f$ in each subregion is attained when we have the *largest* possible $x$ and the *largest* possible $y.$ This is the value at the *top right corner* of each subregion. 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14255149/assets/4a10c8332a5f346d393c37531c13db6aa69d4cecb241efd7c34d57f32d5a98b8.png)

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}{m}_{ij} & =f({x}_{i},{y}_{j})=11-3{x}_{i}-4{y}_{j}\end{aligned}
$$

for all $1\le i\le m$ and $1\le j\le n.$

Finally, the lower Riemann sum is 

$$
\begin{aligned}L(f,P) & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}(11-3{x}_{i}-4{y}_{j})Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the missing expression is $11-3{x}_{i}-4{y}_{j}.$
